name: Add promo code discount with price floor and order of operations
description: Add SUMMER20 promotional discount (20% off) applied after tier discount, enforcing a $5.00 minimum price floor in src/discount.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Update applyDiscount in src/discount.ts to support the promo code 'SUMMER20', which takes an additional 20% off the price remaining after customer tier discount (STANDARD: 0%, PREMIUM: 10%, VIP: 20%). The final price must never drop below MIN_PRICE ($5.00), unless original basePrice was already under $5.00 (in which case it remains basePrice). Round all final amounts to 2 decimal places. Ensure all tests in test/discount.test.ts pass.

acceptance_criteria: STANDARD tier has 0% discount, PREMIUM 10%, VIP 20%
